subject: Vendor portal URN mismatch, PO auto-attach & accelerated remit eligibility
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@adeptium.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Cc: contracts@adeptium.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding docs + question on payment timing (Adeptium)

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the warm welcome — excited to get onboarding finished so we can start sending POs. Quick background: our finance team needs to confirm the URN you have for Adeptium in your vendor portal is ADEPT-4921 so our remittance system can auto-attach POs and invoices. When we tried to upload our first invoice the portal rejected the URN and asked for a validation doc.

Also: we normally invoice Net 30 but we saw in the onboarding checklist that Redwood defaults to Net 45 for new suppliers. Is there any flexibility for an accelerated remit (Net 30) for the first 60 days while we ramp? If so, please let us know what paperwork you need and whether an early-pay enrollment or discount is required.

I attached our W-9 and a sample invoice to this note. Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Sofia Alvarez
Head of Finance Operations
Adeptium Solutions
sofia@adeptium.com

---
From: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com (Markus Klein)
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@adeptium.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>, contracts@adeptium.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + question on payment timing (Adeptium)

Hi Sofia — welcome 👋

Thanks for the attachments, I pulled them into the vendor portal. Two quick items from our side:

1) URN mismatch: Our vendor portal shows ADEPT-4920 (older record). Procurement will need to confirm we should update to ADEPT-4921 before we enable PO auto-attach. Updating the URN requires a signed vendor change form (we can route that via DocuSign).

2) Payment timing: Standard new-supplier cadence here is Net 45 while PO auto-attach and invoice routing are verified. We can make an exception to Net 30 for an initial 60-day pilot if Procurement & Finance sign off. Typical trade-off is a small admin surcharge or an early-pay fee (0.5%–1% of invoice); alternatively, we can set Net 45 with a 7-day accelerated remit on approved invoices.

Looping in Marissa (procurement) and Priyom (finance ops) to confirm internal appetite. Marissa — can Procurement push the URN update through the portal and open a DocuSign change? Priyom — is Redwood Finance able to approve a two-month Net 30 pilot for Adeptium if they accept a 0.5% early-pay fee or provide net-30 payment confirmation via the vendor portal?

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood-inference.com

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood-inference.com>, Sofia Alvarez <sofia@adeptium.com>, contracts@adeptium.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + question on payment timing (Adeptium)

Markus / Sofia — thanks, I opened the vendor change request and kicked off a DocuSign to update the URN (link below). Once the DocuSign is signed, IT will re-run the portal validation and enable PO auto-attach.

On accelerated remit: Procurement is okay to support a two-month Net 30 pilot for Adeptium on the condition that:
- Adeptium confirms they will accept a 0.5% early-pay processing fee OR provide an e-invoice feed (SFTP/supplier API) to reduce manual touches.
- Adeptium provides the signed Vendor Change Form and the W-9 (received).
- We limit pilot volume to <= $50k/month for two months; after that we’ll reassess based on on-time delivery and invoice accuracy.

Sofia — can you confirm which option you prefer (fee vs e-invoice)? If fee, please send the billing contact and the name to appear on the invoice so we can set the vendor attributes. If e-invoice, send the SFTP endpoint or API spec and our Tech Integrations team will circulate a checklist.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/adeptium-contract-EXP12345
Vendor change request id: VCR-2027-0619-ADEPT

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

---
From: Darren Liu <darren.liu@adeptium.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, markus_klein@redwood-inference.com
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@adeptium.com>, contracts@adeptium.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding docs + question on payment timing (Adeptium)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the quick turn. We can do the 0.5% early-pay processing fee to get Net 30 for the first 60 days; please set the billing name to Adeptium Solutions Inc. and billing contact to accounts.payable@adeptium.com.

I also confirmed the URN on our side should be ADEPT-4921 — Sofia will sign the DocuSign today. We attached the W-9 and a sample invoice in our first email; I included a short text file with the DocuSign link in case your portal needs it.

Looking forward to the test period — let us know when PO auto-attach is live and we’ll start sending Net 30 invoices.

Best,
Darren Liu
VP, Finance
Adeptium Solutions
darren.liu@adeptium.com
